profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Eleven Software
profile.summary: I'm a Principal Software Engineer and Urban Sketcher.

positions.title: Web Developer/Assistant Manager, IT
positions.description: Gather requirements for, design, and develop complete data-driven intranet web applications using .NET Web Forms and MVC, C# and VB.NET, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL Server, and Visual Studio.  As half of a two-person team with the IT Manager, provide technical support for 130+ staff at three main offices and many satellite offices and provide backup to IT Manager.

positions.title: Senior Project Assistant
positions.description: Managed implementation of new technical services and procedures. Redeveloped Access 2002 projects into ASP.NET web applications.

positions.title: Web Specialist
positions.description: Create Perl CGI scripts for use in intranet applications in a Unix environment. Gather requirements and work with managers to plan and develop new websites and technology-based solutions. Provide technical support for Macintosh users.

certifications.name: Advanced SQL: Logical Query Processing, Part 1
